grade: 七年级下 ~ 八年级上
unit: can / must / should / may 专题
summary: 情态动词表示能力、许可、义务、推测等：can（能）、must（必须）、should（应该）、may（可以）。后接动词原形，没有人称和数的变化。

rules.title: can：能力与许可
rules.detail: 表示「能、会」（能力）或「可以」（许可）。否定 can't / cannot。can 后必须用动词原形。

examples.en: Can I borrow your pen? — Of course.
examples.zh: 我能借你的钢笔吗？——当然。

rules.title: must（必须）与 mustn't（禁止）
rules.detail: must 表示义务「必须做」；mustn't 表示强烈禁止「千万别做」。注意：must 的否定回答用 needn't（不必），不用 mustn't！

examples.en: You must finish your homework first.
We mustn't swim in this river. It's dangerous.
examples.zh: 我们禁止在这条河里游泳，很危险。

examples.en: — Must I clean the room now? — No, you needn't.
examples.zh: ——我现在必须打扫房间吗？——不，不必。

rules.title: should（应该）与 may（可以/可能）
rules.detail: should 表示建议「应该做」；may 表示许可或可能性。同样后接动词原形。

examples.en: You should drink more water when you have a cold.

pitfalls: 情态动词后动词变形：❌ He can swims. → ✓ He can swim.
must 问句的否定回答：❌ — Must I go? — No, you mustn't.（意思是「禁止去」）→ ✓ No, you needn't.（不必去）
两个情态动词连用：❌ He must can do it. → ✓ He must be able to do it.

questions.stem: — ___ I take the magazine out of the reading room? — Sorry, you ___.
questions.explain: may 表许可提问；拒绝用 mustn't（禁止）。

questions.stem: You look tired. You ___ go to bed early tonight.
questions.explain: 给出建议「应该早睡」用 should。

questions.stem: Lucy is only five, but she ___ play the piano very well.
questions.explain: 表示能力「会弹钢琴」用 can。

questions.stem: Students ___ talk loudly in the library.
questions.explain: 图书馆里禁止大声说话，用 mustn't。

questions.stem: You ___ (not; 允许) smoke here. It's a school.
questions.explain: 表示「不允许」用 can't / mustn't。

questions.stem: — Must I hand in my homework today? — No, you ___ (不必).
questions.explain: must 问句的否定回答用 needn't（不必），mustn't 是「禁止」。

questions.stem: My brother can plays chess very well.
questions.explain: 情态动词 can 后接动词原形 play。

questions.stem: 你应该每天刷牙两次。（翻译整句）
answer: you should brush your teeth twice a day.
you should brush your teeth two times a day.
questions.explain: should + 动词原形 brush；twice a day 表示一天两次。

questions.stem: 她会说英语，还会一点法语。（翻译整句）
answer: she can speak english, and she can also speak a little french.
she can speak english and a little french, too.
questions.explain: can 后接原形；a little 修饰不可数名词 french（法语）。
